official_definition: Flash- Violent High Speed (Either Attack Step) If there are five or more cores in your Trash, by sending all the cores from your Trash to the Field/Reserve, summon this card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Violent High Speed] or [Violent High Speed: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Violent High Speed]", "give [Violent High Speed]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
